## Export settings activity {#export-settings-activity}

Download settings activity as a CSV file to keep an audit trail of administrative changes outside of the {{< var validmind.platform >}}.

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa wifi >}} Activity**, then select the **Settings Activity** tab.

2. (Optional) Apply filters to narrow down the events you want to export.

3. Click **{{< fa download >}} Export** next to the filters.

4. The Export Activity dialog shows how many events match your filters. Click **Export** to download them.

   The export includes up to the 10,000 most recent matching events. To export older events, narrow your filters, for example by date.

Your browser downloads a file named `settings-activity-log-<date>.csv`, for example `settings-activity-log-2026-11-03.csv`. Each row is one event, sorted from newest to oldest:

| Column | Contents |
|---|---|
| Timestamp (UTC) | Date and time of the change in UTC. |
| Actor | User or API client that made the change. Automated changes show `System`. |
| Actor Email | Email address of the user who made the change. |
| Area | Settings area the change was made in. |
| Description | What changed, in the same words the Settings Activity feed uses. |
| Target Type | Type of item that was changed. |
| Target | Name of the item that was changed. |
| Changes | Previous and new values, when the feed shows them, for example `Name: Old → New`. |
| Event ID | Unique identifier of the event. |

: **Settings activity CSV columns** {.hover tbl-colwidths="[25,75]"}

Values that start with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@` are prefixed with an apostrophe (`'`) so spreadsheet applications don't run them as formulas.
